The Verses of the Elder Senaka:
“Welcome indeed was it for me at Gayā,
on the full moon day of the month of Kattika.”
I saw the Fully Awakened One teaching the supreme Dhamma,
the teacher of the assembly, possessed of great radiance.
the Victor of the world including its devas, whose vision is incomparable.
The great naga, the great hero,
of great radiance and free from taints,
whose all taints are utterly exhausted.
The Teacher, who is fearless from every side.
Alas, for so long have I been defiled,
bound by the fetters of wrong views!
“The Blessed One has liberated Senaka from all bonds.
